`infrastructure` may import only a strictly lower tier. `http/` composes freely
but may never reach into another module's `http/` or `infrastructure/`.

May import: _nothing above platform_.

- `GET /admin/activity`
- `GET /admin/activity/actors`
- `POST /admin/activity/clear`
- `POST /operation/activity`

## Invariants

<!-- invariants:start -->

Append-only administration journal. One successful (or failed deploy) change
to the running application is one row. Origins are `admin` (browser, always
with `actor_user_id`), `operator` (CLI / deploy, no shop account), and
`system` (cron / worker). No update or delete API. Detail is redacted and
capped. Loyalty money stays in `loyalty_ledger`; a journal row is written in
the same transaction for manual credit and debit only as a cross-cutting
history line.

<!-- invariants:end -->
